responsibilities_summary: Operates and maintains the national electricity grid: generation, transmission, distribution. Handles grid-side outages, power line faults, transformer failures, meter issues, and public lighting on EDL-owned infrastructure.
default_use_in_routing: Route grid-side electricity faults here. HITL required to confirm EDL vs private generator. Exception: Zahle district → EDZ not EDL.
conflict_note: Zahle district exception: EDZ concession, not EDL. See SAM-ELEC-002.

responsibilities_summary: Municipalities handle local roads, sidewalks, street cleaning, solid waste collection, public parks, local drainage, building permits, and general civic services within their administrative boundaries.
default_use_in_routing: Default resolver for local civic complaints within a municipality boundary. Use municipality_official_channels.csv for per-municipality contact. Route to municipal union if a shared service is verified.
conflict_note: MUN is dynamic — resolved to a specific municipality via GPS/address. See national_municipality_registry.csv.

entity_name_en: Ministry of Public Works and Transport
responsibilities_summary: Responsible for classified/national roads, bridges, highway maintenance, snow clearance on national routes, large public works, and transport regulation. Maintains regional offices with road units that handle citizen road complaints.
default_use_in_routing: Route complaints on classified/national roads or bridges. If road class is ambiguous (local vs national), send to HITL. CDR handles active construction sites only.

parent_body: Presidency of the Council of Ministers
responsibilities_summary: Plans, finances, and supervises major national development and reconstruction projects. Acts as project owner for capital infrastructure (roads, water, buildings). NOT a day-to-day field service entity — escalation/project complaints only.
default_use_in_routing: Use only when complaint explicitly references an active CDR project site or reconstruction zone. Escalation entity for large infrastructure, not routine service.
conflict_note: CDR is a project owner, not a complaint resolver. Only use when GPS matches a known active CDR project.
hq_address: Tallet Al Serail - Riad El Solh, Beirut

entity_name_en: Beirut and Mount Lebanon Water Establishment
responsibilities_summary: Beirut and Mount Lebanon Water Establishment. Manages potable water supply, billing, and pipe network for Beirut city and Mount Lebanon governorate. Handles water outages, pipe leaks, dirty water, billing disputes, and new connection requests in its service area.
default_use_in_routing: Route water complaints from Beirut or Mount Lebanon governorate here. Confirm governorate via GPS.
hq_address: Beirut - Badaro - Sami Soloh Street, EBML Building

responsibilities_summary: North Lebanon Water Establishment. Manages potable water supply, customer complaints, service requests, billing/payment, and branch follow-up for North Lebanon and Akkar runtime scope.
default_use_in_routing: Route water complaints from North Lebanon or Aakkar governorate here after municipality/GPS confirmation.
hq_address: Tripoli - Salahuddine Kabbara Street, Dam w Farz

responsibilities_summary: South Lebanon Water Establishment. Manages drinking-water distribution, wastewater collection/treatment/disposal, customer-service faults, billing, e-payment, and district distribution follow-up for South Lebanon and Nabatieh.
default_use_in_routing: Route water complaints from South Lebanon or Nabatiyeh governorate here after municipality/GPS confirmation; keep Litani/Qasimiya/Ras Al Ain irrigation as LRA/HITL boundary.

responsibilities_summary: Bekaa Water Establishment. Manages potable water supply and network for Bekaa governorate (Zahle, Baalbek-Hermel, West Bekaa, Rashaya). Emergency line: 1700.
default_use_in_routing: Route water complaints from Bekaa or Baalbek-Hermel governorate here.
hq_address: Zahle Highway, Abed Deyem Building, Floors 3 & 4

responsibilities_summary: Ministry of Energy and Water. Policy and regulatory authority over electricity sector (supervises EDL, EDZ, generators), water sector (supervises 4 water establishments), and oil infrastructure. Handles ministerial-level escalations when EDL/water authority fails to respond. NOT an operational complaint body — routes field complaints to relevant entity.
default_use_in_routing: Escalation/policy layer only. Route field faults to EDL or the relevant regional water establishment first.
conflict_note: MOEW in seed = MEW in routing
hq_address: Beirut, Fern el Shebak, Garius Center, Floors 9-11

responsibilities_summary: State telecom operator managing fixed-line, DSL, VDSL, and fiber infrastructure across Lebanon. Handles landline faults, fixed internet outages, physical damage to telecom cabinets and cables, and low-speed complaints on OGERO infrastructure. Does NOT handle mobile network or billing issues for Alfa/Touch.
default_use_in_routing: Route fixed-line internet and landline faults here. HITL until TELECOM sector is fully implemented. Do not use for mobile/cellular.
hq_address: Beirut, Bir Hasan, Ziad Rahbani Avenue

responsibilities_summary: Responsible for internal security, law enforcement, public order, traffic regulation, crime prevention, and investigative police work. HITL always required — never auto-route criminal or safety matters.
default_use_in_routing: HITL always required. Reviewer confirms entity and urgency before any action. ISF for criminal and public safety matters.

responsibilities_summary: Emergency rescue and firefighting authority. Responds to fires, building collapses, floods, chemical/gas hazards, traffic accident rescue, mountain/sea rescue, entrapment, and mass casualty incidents. Always first responder for any life-safety emergency. Coordinates with ISF and MPWT after scene is secured.
default_use_in_routing: Always route any life-safety emergency here first. HITL required to confirm scene and dispatch. Never delay routing for missing location — emergency address can be taken on call. Call 125 immediately.
conflict_note: CIVIL_DEFENSE in seed = CD in routing
hq_address: Civil Defense General Directorate, Tallet el-Khayat, Beirut

responsibilities_summary: Ministry of Environment. Responsible for environmental protection, industrial pollution control, waste regulation, air and water quality, environmental impact assessments, and enforcement of environmental law. Handles complaints about illegal dumping, industrial pollution, air quality violations, river/coastal pollution, and quarry/crusher noise.
default_use_in_routing: Route hazardous/environmental violations here. Routine waste collection → MUN first. Co-route with ISF/CD for dangerous spills.
hq_address: Azarieh Building, 7th and 8th floors, Beirut Central District

responsibilities_summary: Electricite De Zahle (EDZ). Private electricity concession serving Zahle district (Bekaa). Operates independently of EDL. Handles outages, billing, and grid faults specifically within the Zahle concession area.
default_use_in_routing: Use ONLY for confirmed Zahle district address. HITL required until GPS confirms Zahle district vs rest of Bekaa.
conflict_note: EDL is NOT the entity for Zahle electricity. See SAM-ELEC-002.

responsibilities_summary: Ministry of Interior and Municipalities. Oversees local governance including municipalities, qadaa-level administration, civil affairs (ID, passports), and the General Directorate of Local Administrations (DGLAC). Escalation authority for inter-municipal disputes and municipal non-compliance.
default_use_in_routing: Escalation/oversight layer for municipal governance issues, not default resolver for local service defects.

entity_name_en: General Directorate of Local Administrations and Councils
responsibilities_summary: Official local-administration portal, municipal directory, local-council departments and transaction/form tracking context.
default_use_in_routing: Use as registry/source-discovery evidence; only use as intake channel if specific DGLAC form behavior is verified.

parent_body: Presidency of the Council of Ministers
responsibilities_summary: Central Inspection Board. Administrative oversight body with jurisdiction over all public sector bodies and municipalities. Investigates complaints of administrative misconduct, corruption, negligence, and violations of civil service law. Escalation route when direct complaint to entity fails.
Independent telecom regulator for consumer rights, competition, licensing, spectrum, market oversight, and service-provider complaint escalation.
default_use_in_routing: Use after provider complaint is unresolved or for regulatory/billing consumer complaints. Fixed-line technical faults go to OGERO first.
conflict_note: Not first-line for routine fixed OGERO outages; use for mobile/regulatory/billing escalation.
